node.statement: Level-one norm conversion: the level-one inner-product/norm comparison registered in def-ha-map and column-hilbert-inner-product-displays gives universal kappa and e_q>0 such that q_P(Y)<=kappa||Y|| and ||Y||<=kappa q_P(Y) for Y in S_{P,Q} when e<=e_q; hence q_P(u_P dot X_j-X_j)<=kappa^2*C_co*e*q_P(X_j).
